description:
The Eclipse project 'DataProcessor' has compilation errors because its library dependencies are not on the build path. The project's lib/ folder contains three JAR files (commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar, gson-2.10.1.jar, slf4j-api-2.0.9.jar) that need to be added to the Java Build Path.

Your tasks:
1. Open the Java Build Path configuration for the DataProcessor project (right-click project > Build Path > Configure Build Path)
2. Under the Libraries tab, add all three JAR files from the project's lib/ folder
3. Ensure src/main/java is configured as a source folder under the Source tab (it is currently missing from the build path)
4. Apply the changes and verify that all compilation errors are resolved
5. Confirm the project builds successfully with no errors in the Problems view

The project contains three Java source files: App.java, JsonTransformer.java, and TextAnalyzer.java. After correctly configuring the build path, all files should compile without errors.
